$description: A fixture in the shape of @oxyhq/bloom/design-tokens/tokens.json, small enough to assert byte-for-byte. Two presets, both schemes, four tokens. 'teal' is listed before 'mono' and the tokens are listed out of order on purpose: the generator sorts, and a fixture already in sorted order could not tell that apart from a generator that preserves the document's order. The two colour values share an RGB triple and differ only in alpha, so a byte-order mistake in the DTCG-to-SkColor conversion cannot pass as correct.

mono.$description: Fixture preset carrying a gate, so the emitted comment covers that shape too.
